data.name: ReadQuestionHead
data.value: SELECT effect_key,company_id,bank_profile_id,news_material_id,literal_object_ref,current_revision_id FROM questions WHERE effect_id=@id

data.name: ReadEffectHead
data.value: SELECT effect_key,company_id,bank_profile_id,news_material_id,literal_object_ref,current_revision_id FROM effects WHERE effect_id=@id

data.name: ReadQuestionHistory
data.value: SELECT payload_json FROM question_revisions WHERE effect_id=@id ORDER BY sequence

data.name: ReadEffectHistory
data.value: SELECT payload_json FROM effect_revisions WHERE effect_id=@id ORDER BY sequence

data.name: HasPendingInvalidation
data.value: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events e WHERE e.effect_id=@id AND e.known_ticks<=@asof AND e.kind='invalidated' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_validity_events n WHERE n.effect_id=e.effect_id AND n.material_id=e.material_id AND n.known_ticks<=@asof AND (n.known_ticks>e.known_ticks OR (n.known_ticks=e.known_ticks AND n.event_id>e.event_id))))

data.name: InitializeNewsJobs
FindJobRequest
data.value: SELECT request_hash,payload FROM news_jobs WHERE job_id=@id

data.name: ReadSourceCursor
data.value: SELECT payload FROM source_cursor WHERE id=1

data.name: ReadSourceCursorVersion
data.value: SELECT version FROM source_cursor WHERE id=1

data.name: UpsertSourceCursor
data.value: INSERT INTO source_cursor VALUES(1,@v,@p) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET version=excluded.version,payload=excluded.payload

data.name: FindClaimableJob
data.value: SELECT job_id FROM news_jobs WHERE (status IN ('queued','partial') OR (status='running' AND lease_ticks<@now)) ORDER BY updated_ticks LIMIT 1

data.name: FindClaimableJobById
data.value: SELECT job_id FROM news_jobs WHERE (status IN ('queued','partial') OR (status='running' AND lease_ticks<@now)) AND job_id=@id ORDER BY updated_ticks LIMIT 1

data.name: ReadJob
data.value: SELECT payload FROM news_jobs WHERE job_id=@id

data.name: InsertJob
data.value: INSERT INTO news_jobs VALUES(@id,@hash,@s,@v,@w,@l,@t,@p)

data.name: UpdateJob
data.value: UPDATE news_jobs SET status=@s,version=@v,worker=@w,lease_ticks=@l,updated_ticks=@t,payload=@p WHERE job_id=@id

data.name: InsertJobEvent
data.value: INSERT INTO news_job_events VALUES(@id,@v,@p)

data.name: FindAffectedQuestions
data.value: SELECT q.effect_id FROM questions q JOIN question_revisions r ON r.revision_id=q.current_revision_id WHERE q.effect_id>@after AND (insight_utc_ticks((r.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))<=@time OR (@projection=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_revisions h WHERE h.effect_id=q.effect_id AND insight_utc_ticks((h.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))<=@time))) AND (jsonb_array_length(CAST(@companies AS jsonb))=0 OR q.company_id IN (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(@companies AS jsonb)))) AND (@projection=1 OR ( NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.payload_json::jsonb #> '{sourceRefs}') s WHERE (s.value::jsonb #>> '{materialId}')=@material AND (s.value::jsonb #>> '{versionId}')=@version) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_dependencies d WHERE d.effect_id=q.effect_id AND d.material_id=@material) OR q.company_id IN (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(@companies AS jsonb)))))) UNION ALL SELECT 'watch_' || a.analysis_id FROM analysis_receipts a WHERE 'watch_' || a.analysis_id>@after AND jsonb_array_length(a.payload_json::jsonb #> '{effects}')=0 AND insight_utc_ticks((a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))<=@time AND (((@projection=1 OR @category='material:market') AND jsonb_array_length(CAST(@companies AS jsonb))=0) OR a.company_id IN (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(@companies AS jsonb)))) AND NOT ((a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{trigger,materialId}') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @material AND (a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{trigger,versionId}') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @version) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analysis_receipts n WHERE n.company_id=a.company_id AND n.news_material_id=a.news_material_id AND insight_utc_ticks((n.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))<= @time AND (insight_utc_ticks((n.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))>insight_utc_ticks((a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}')) OR (insight_utc_ticks((n.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))=insight_utc_ticks((a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}')) AND (insight_utc_ticks((n.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{completedAt}'))>insight_utc_ticks((a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{completedAt}')) OR ((n.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{completedAt}')=(a.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{completedAt}') AND n.analysis_id>a.analysis_id))))) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 65

data.name: ReadAnalysisWatch
data.value: SELECT payload_json FROM analysis_receipts WHERE analysis_id=@id

data.name: UpsertQuestionInvalidation
data.value: INSERT INTO question_invalidations VALUES(@id,@material,@version) ON CONFLICT(effect_id,material_id) DO UPDATE SET version_id=excluded.version_id

data.name: UpsertInvalidationTime
data.value: INSERT INTO question_invalidation_times VALUES(@id,@material,@known) ON CONFLICT(effect_id,material_id) DO UPDATE SET known_ticks=excluded.known_ticks

data.name: InsertInvalidationEvent
data.value: INSERT INTO question_validity_events(effect_id,material_id,kind,version_id,known_ticks) VALUES(@id,@material,'invalidated',@version,@known) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

data.name: InitializeEffects
FindSnapshotEffects
data.value: SELECT effect_id FROM effects WHERE company_id=@company AND news_material_id=@material UNION ALL SELECT effect_id FROM questions WHERE company_id=@company ORDER BY effect_id

data.name: FindPreviousQuestion
data.value: SELECT effect_id FROM questions WHERE company_id=@company AND current_revision_id=@previous

data.name: RekeyQuestion
data.value: UPDATE questions SET effect_key=@key WHERE effect_id=@id

data.name: InsertQuestion
data.value: INSERT INTO questions(effect_id,company_id,bank_profile_id,news_material_id,effect_key,literal_object_ref) VALUES(@id,@company,@bank,@material,@key,@literal)

data.name: InsertEffect
data.value: INSERT INTO effects(effect_id,company_id,bank_profile_id,news_material_id,effect_key,literal_object_ref) VALUES(@id,@company,@bank,@material,@key,@literal)

data.name: InsertQuestionRevision
data.value: INSERT INTO question_revisions(revision_id,effect_id,previous_revision_id,news_version_id,sequence,payload_json) VALUES(@revision,@effect,@previous,@version,@sequence,@json)

data.name: InsertEffectRevision
data.value: INSERT INTO effect_revisions(revision_id,effect_id,previous_revision_id,news_version_id,sequence,payload_json) VALUES(@revision,@effect,@previous,@version,@sequence,@json)

data.name: AdvanceQuestionHead
data.value: UPDATE questions SET current_revision_id=@revision WHERE effect_id=@effect AND current_revision_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @previous

data.name: AdvanceEffectHead
data.value: UPDATE effects SET current_revision_id=@revision WHERE effect_id=@effect AND current_revision_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM @previous

data.name: DeleteQuestionDependencies
data.value: DELETE FROM question_dependencies WHERE effect_id=@id

data.name: InsertQuestionDependency
data.value: INSERT INTO question_dependencies VALUES(@id,@material,@version)

data.name: ClearQuestionInvalidation
data.value: DELETE FROM question_invalidations WHERE effect_id=@id AND material_id=@material AND version_id=@version

data.name: InsertClearedValidityEvent
data.value: INSERT INTO question_validity_events(effect_id,material_id,kind,version_id,known_ticks) VALUES(@id,@material,'cleared',@version,@known) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

data.name: ClearInvalidationTime
data.value: DELETE FROM question_invalidation_times WHERE effect_id=@id AND material_id=@material AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_invalidations i WHERE i.effect_id=@id AND i.material_id=@material)

data.name: FindUnrevisedEffects
data.value: SELECT e.effect_id FROM effects e JOIN effect_revisions r ON r.revision_id=e.current_revision_id WHERE e.company_id=@company AND e.news_material_id=@material AND r.news_version_id<>@version UNION ALL SELECT q.effect_id FROM questions q JOIN question_revisions qr ON qr.revision_id=q.current_revision_id WHERE q.company_id=@company AND (CAST(@mechanisms AS text) IS NULL OR (qr.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{question,mechanism}') IN (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CAST(@mechanisms AS jsonb)))) ORDER BY effect_id

data.name: InsertAnalysisReceipt
data.value: INSERT INTO analysis_receipts(analysis_id,company_id,news_material_id,news_version_id,request_hash,payload_json) VALUES(@id,@company,@material,@version,@hash,@json)

data.name: ReadCompanyStateVersion
data.value: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM effect_revisions r JOIN effects e ON e.effect_id=r.effect_id WHERE e.company_id=@company) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_revisions r JOIN questions q ON q.effect_id=r.effect_id WHERE q.company_id=@company)

data.name: FindQuestionRecipients
data.value: SELECT DISTINCT q.company_id FROM questions q JOIN question_revisions r ON r.revision_id=q.current_revision_id WHERE q.company_id>@after AND insight_utc_ticks((r.payload_json::jsonb #>> '{asOf}'))<=@asOf AND (CAST(@material AS text) IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_dependencies d WHERE d.effect_id=q.effect_id AND d.material_id=@material)) ORDER BY q.company_id LIMIT 257

data.name: FindAnalysisReceipt
data.value: SELECT request_hash,payload_json FROM analysis_receipts WHERE company_id=@company AND news_material_id=@material AND news_version_id=@version

data.name: TransactionLock
data.value: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(714103201)

data.name: RowsEnvelope
data.value: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(rows)), '[]'::json)::text FROM ({0}) rows

data.name: AffectedRowsEnvelope
data.value: WITH affected AS ({0} RETURNING 1) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM affected

data.name: CreateUtcTicks
data.value: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION insight_utc_ticks(value text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $ticks$ SELECT (extract(epoch FROM regexp_replace(value, '\.[0-9]+', '')::timestamptz) * 10000000)::bigint + COALESCE(rpad(substring(value from '\.([0-9]+)'), 7, '0')::bigint, 0) + 621355968000000000 $ticks$;
